subject: Eval roadmap & commercial proposal — request for MAP timeline confirmation
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acrotech.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Eval roadmap & commercial proposal — request for MAP timeline confirmation

Hi Lena,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to learn more about AcroTech's evaluation goals and volume expectations. Per our conversation, I'm attaching an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP_v1.pdf) and a short commercial outline to align on milestones and pricing as you run the POC. High-level proposal: 

- Evaluation window: 30 days (POC start -> completion)
- MAP checkpoints: Kickoff (week 0), Mid-eval (day 14), Acceptance (day 30)
- Pricing (baseline): hosted API tier at $0.018 / 1K tokens for evaluation traffic; pilot credits applied for first 250k tokens
- Ramp / commit incentives: 10% discount at a 3 month 100k/mo committed run-rate; 20% discount at 6 month 300k/mo commit
- Missed-ramp protection: pro-rated credits if ramp targets are not hit in month 1 of production

Questions for you:
1) Does the proposed checkpoint schedule map to your internal decision gates?
2) Do you need us to include SOC2 / security artifacts up front for procurement?
3) Who should be on the procurement thread for contract and PO discussions?

If that looks reasonable I'll loop in Marissa (AE) and Dev (Sales Ops) with a revised commercial that ties discounts to the specific MAP milestones. Can we target a signature window in the week of Dec 6-10 so we can hit activation in early January?

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Attachment: MAP_v1.pdf (summary of milestones, acceptance criteria)

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acrotech.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: AcroTech Procurement <procurement@acrotech.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acrotech.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Eval roadmap & commercial proposal — request for MAP timeline confirmation

Ben — thanks for the quick follow. The MAP timing looks fine but a couple of asks from our side: 

- Procurement will need the SOC2 Type II report and a written data retention/processing summary before we put this on our PO queue.
- Commercially, we typically need a stronger first-quarter ramp commitment to consider a 20% discount — can you map the 20% to a specific 90-day commit?
- Please include Jordan (lead of the AI platform team) on the technical acceptance criteria — he will own the evaluation sign-off.

We'd like to see: 1) revised pricing that ties the 20% discount to a 90-day commit (specific volumes), and 2) a version of the MAP that enumerates pass/fail checks at Mid-eval and Acceptance. Can Marissa/Dev be included? Procurement is on CC.

Best,

Lena Ortiz
Director, Product Innovation | AcroTech Solutions
lena.ortiz@acrotech.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acrotech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acrotech.com>, AcroTech Procurement <procurement@acrotech.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Eval roadmap & commercial proposal — request for MAP timeline confirmation

Thanks Lena — looping in Marissa (AE) and Dev (Sales Ops) to finalize commercial terms and the procurement checklist. Per your ask we've produced a revised MAP and pricing attachment (MAP_v2.pdf) and a draft SOW (SOW_draft.docx). Summary of commercial changes in MAP_v2: 

- 20% discount is now tied to a 90-day committed run-rate (90 days @ >= 300k tokens / month) starting at production go-live (defined as 7 days after contract signature)
- 10% discount remains available at 30-day 100k/mo commit
- Ramp credits: if monthly committed volume is missed by >25% in the first month, Redwood will issue a one-time service credit equal to 25% of that month's usage charges (documented in SOW)
- Acceptance criteria: Mid-eval (day 14) — throughput and latency tests pass; Acceptance (day 30) — quality regression rate <= 3% on agreed prompt set. Failure mode: 14-day remediation plan, pause of discount clock until remediation complete

Operational asks for procurement: 
- We will provide SOC2 Type II summary link and a short data retention FAQ (see links below).
- Billing: Redwood supports Net 30 invoicing; we can accept a PO.

DocuSign prep: we can seed the agreement and commercial schedule in DocuSign for quick signatures. Link attached.

Next actionable items: 
- Procurement confirms that Net 30 and the above ramp-credit approach are acceptable
- Jordan confirms the mid-eval and acceptance criteria bullets
- If all good, Marissa will send the updated commercial offer and DocuSign envelope by EOD.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments: MAP_v2.pdf, SOW_draft.docx
Related links: https://app.docusign.com/DocuSign/AcroProposal-1457

From: AcroTech Procurement <procurement@acrotech.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acrotech.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acrotech.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Eval roadmap & commercial proposal — request for MAP timeline confirmation

Ben / Marissa / Dev — thanks for the update and the new materials. A few procurement/legal items before we can route the PO: 

- Please provide the SOC2 Type II report (redacted copy is fine) and the data retention policy URL.
- We require a full billing schedule that lists monthly invoice line items and the PO-friendly description for charges (e.g., "Redwood Inference — Hosted LLM inference — Dec 2026 — 300k tokens").
- Net 30 is acceptable; however, we need explicit language around service credits and how they will be applied to invoices (credit memos). Can you confirm the remittance flow?
- Legal will review standard T&Cs; we will upload any redlines into the DocuSign envelope. Please send the envelope and a versioned PDF of the commercial schedule.

Procurement would like to target signature by Dec 10 if the docs and SOC2 material are available this week.

On the acceptance criteria: Jordan from our AI team will confirm technical specifics once he reviews MAP_v2.

Best regards,

Samantha Price
Senior Buyer, Strategic Sourcing | AcroTech Solutions
procurement@acrotech.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Eval roadmap & commercial proposal — request for MAP timeline confirmation

Samantha / team — appreciate the clarity. Quick summary of what we'll deliver by EOD Friday: 

- SOC2 Type II redacted report link and a short data retention FAQ (we'll include a one-page summary for procurement)
- Versioned commercial schedule PDF and a DocuSign envelope seeded for signature (Marissa will send)
- Explicit billing line-item language and confirmation that credits will be issued as credit memos applied to the next invoice cycle (Net 30 remains unchanged)

Proposed next steps and timeline: 
- Dec 3: Redwood sends SOC2 link, commercial schedule PDF, and DocuSign envelope
- Dec 6: Procurement reviews and returns any DocuSign redlines / PO details
- Dec 10: Target signature date (goal: execution this week to meet Jan activation)

Jordan — when you have a chance, please reply with any adjustments to the Mid-eval/Acceptance metrics in MAP_v2 (I highlighted the two key thresholds in the doc). If procurement is comfortable with the credit memo flow, we'll proceed to DocuSign.

Thanks — will follow up after we upload the SOC2 link.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
